{{Quote|Suddenly I feel a little claustrophobic. Let's get moving, huh?|Kira Carsen to the Hero of Tython|<ref name="ROTHC">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|Ambient dialogue in [[Makeb]]}}</ref>}}
'''Claustrophobia''' was the fear of enclosed spaces. It was capable in manifesting in [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] and non-sentient alike, such as [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Banshee bird/Legends|Corellian banshee birds]]. Known claustrophobes included [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kira Carsen]], and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] according to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] reports. The [[Praxeum ship/Legends|praxeum ship]] ''[[Chu'unthor]]'' was designed to negate the effects of claustrophobia while traveling in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. 

==Description==
{{Quote|Have I mentioned I have a problem with enclosed spaces?|Kira Carsen on her dislike of enclosed spaces|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Claustrophobia was the fear of enclosed spaces as found in [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] such as [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="TOR" /> and in non-sentient species such as the [[Banshee bird/Legends|Corellian banshee bird]]. Corellian banshee birds, native to<ref name="Threats">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], were naturally claustrophobic. Thus, those who domesticated the [[Bird/Legends|birds]] usually kept them in open spaces, such as aviaries.<ref name="Threats" />

==History==
{{Quote|Get this world seeded and clean it up, so we can take down these domes. I'm not claustrophobic, but &ndash;''"<br />"''The Sith you're not.|Doctor Plee and Aj Koenes|<ref name="BP" />}}
[[File:Kira_Carsen_after_Zakuul.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Kira Carsen stated that she had a problem with enclosed spaces.]]
In [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during a [[Mission to Taris (Desolator crisis)|mission]] to the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kira Carsen]] and [[Hero of Tython|another]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;later named the "Hero of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]"&mdash;traveled from the [[Brell Sediment]] to the [[Sinking City]] through the use of a ruined tunnel. Carsen remarked that there had to be another way to the [[City/Legends|city]], stating to her fellow Jedi that she had a problem with enclosed spaces.<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3638 BBY]]<ref name="RotHC-Date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> while on the planet [[Makeb]], Carsen and the Hero of Tython used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to create a [[Force barrier/Legends|barrier]] as protection against [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] reinforcements. Shortly afterward, Carsen made a brief mention that she was beginning to feel claustrophobic, and suggested that they began to get moving.<ref name="ROTHC" />

Built in [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]], the Jedi [[Praxeum ship/Legends|praxeum ship]] ''[[Chu'unthor]]'' was designed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Ivixa Delbaeth]] and [[Fin-So-Rowan/Legends|Fin-So-Rowan]]<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|95|CHU 1-2|''Chu'unthor''}}</ref> with wide corridors, high ceilings, and dozens of domed rooms. This was done to alleviate the sense of claustrophobia common in most [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="EGTVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> 

[[File:RexTroopers-Agenda.png|thumb|left|250px|According to Republic reports, clone troopers displayed symptoms of claustrophobia.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Republic reports claimed that some of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|army's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] displayed the symptoms of claustrophobia in their cramped quarters, which was believed to have been inherited from<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> their Human [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="Skyewalkers" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Jedi [[Halagad Ventor]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were sent to the planet [[Skye/Legends|Skye]] alongside the Republic's [[Tark Squad]], with the intent to [[Battle of Skye|stop]] the [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]]. While crossing through the [[Entyrmion]], a labyrinth-like [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] located under Skye's [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges, Ventor noted that the members of the Tark Squad seemingly showed no signs of claustrophobia, unlike the reports claimed.<ref name="Skyewalkers" />

In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]],<ref name="NJO-Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]'' to [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]].</ref> the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] members [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Plee]] and [[Water/Legends|water]] specialist [[Aj Koenes]] discussed their assignment from the [[Senate Select Committee for Refugees]] to [[Terraforming/Legends|terraform]]<ref name="BP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref> the Core Worlds planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. Plee stated that the [[habitation dome]]s where the planet's [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] resided made her feel claustrophobic.<ref name="BP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Claustrophobia was first mentioned in the [[1996]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'', written by [[Bill Smith]] and published as part of [[Del Rey]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Essential Guides]]''.<ref name="EGTVV" /> Claustrophobia made its first appearance in the [[2011]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="TOR" /> published by [[LucasArts]] and [[Electronic Arts]].<ref name="General-TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Claustrophobia|claustrophobia]] is an [[Wikipedia:Anxiety disorder|anxiety disorder]] that causes an extreme fear of enclosed spaces.<ref name="Claustrophobia">{{WebCite|url=https://www.webmd.com/anxiety-panic/claustrophobia-overview|text=Claustrophobia|author=Stephanie Watson|date=2022-11-09|work=[[Wikipedia:WebMD|WebMD]]|archivedate=20230904150737}}</ref>
